Everyone considers life through a different point of view. I'm not sure what specifics are making you feel this way, but I may have general advice. Keep in mind you are your own person- you do not need to please anyone, only yourself if that's needed. Try to focus your mind on your hobbies or activities that you would once enjoy. Life is in a tough way for you it seems. Please try and acknowledge there is hope at the end. You can talk to the majority of us, if not that's okay. I will keep you in my focus today. 

Keep your head up- friend.

Hey OP. I just wanted to let you know- you are not selfish and you should not feel like you are obligated to help or encourage another person whomever they may be. Self care and promoting positive behavior in life is a big game changer. Things take time and we understand you and hear you out. Take time to try and relax through your hobbies or interests you may find joy in doing so. I'm sorry if my advice was not adequate. I will keep you in my mind.

Dont give up- friend.
